summary: Small summer windswell all week — the clean windows beat the size. Saturday is the standout with offshore mornings at Ditch (1.7-2.2ft prime angle) and Matunuck, and that's the day worth a drive east; Friday has the most size everywhere but short period and iffy winds. Rockaway is fine for a glassy dawn Wednesday or a fun Friday but nothing at home demands more than a home-break effort — head to Ditch Saturday if you want the best day.
